name: Meta Lebanon data center campus
summary: Meta campus of more than USD 10 billion in the LEAP Innovation and Research District in Lebanon, Indiana, Meta's second data center in the state. The state describes a 1,500-acre site with 13 buildings, 10 of them data centers, built in up to six phases; Meta gives a campus size of roughly 4 million square feet. Ground was broken on 11 February 2026, and local reporting expected operations in 2027 or early 2028. Meta planned its power needs with Wabash Valley Power Alliance and Boone Power, and Citizens Energy Group has said it plans to supply water. Indiana granted a performance-based 35-year sales tax exemption tied to at least USD 1 billion of investment in the first six years.
